US.description: Average cost of living across the US, excluding rent, covering groceries, transportation, utilities, and personal expenses.

IN.description: Covers groceries, transportation, utilities, and general daily expenses, which are generally moderate across urban centers.

SG.description: Cost of living in Singapore is generally high, with housing and transportation being significant expenses. However, local food hawker centers offer more affordable dining options, and groceries can vary depending on local vs. imported goods.

CH.description: Exceptionally high cost for groceries, public transportation, utilities, and dining out.

NL.description: Cost of living for essentials like groceries, transportation, utilities, and leisure activities is moderately high.

GB.description: Covers groceries, utilities, public transport, dining, and personal items.

CA.description: Cost of living is moderately high, particularly for groceries, transportation, and utilities. Services and dining out also contribute to higher expenses compared to some other developed nations.

AE.description: High cost of living, particularly for dining, entertainment, and utilities, but groceries can be moderate

NO.description: Norway has a very high cost of living, with groceries, transportation, and dining out being significantly more expensive than average.

IE.description: General cost of living is high, particularly for groceries, utilities, and transportation in urban centers.

LU.description: Very high costs for groceries, dining out, transport, and utilities compared to most European cities.

AU.description: Covers groceries, transportation, utilities, and leisure activities, indicating high costs in major cities

QA.description: Cost of living excluding rent is moderately high, with groceries and utilities being reasonable, but imported goods and certain services can be expensive.

BN.description: The cost of living excluding rent in Brunei Darussalam is moderate, covering expenses like groceries, utilities, local transportation, and modest leisure activities.

MO.description: Cost of living excluding rent is moderate, with reasonable prices for local food and transportation, but imported goods and dining out can be expensive.
